headline: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Heads for $875 Million Opening at Global Box Office
context: The Sony Pictures movie, the 11th big-budget Spider-Man blockbuster since 2002, was on pace to have one of the biggest domestic first weekends ever.

sources.name: The New York Times
